sources.title: Filming in Bermuda (Bermuda Tourism Authority)
sources.said: Planning for a film/video production or a photo shoot in Bermuda includes a few important steps in order to meet the requirements of Bermuda Customs and Immigration, and Bermuda laws and regulations. The Bermuda Tourism Authority is ready to assist in this process. … Persons working on a film, video or photography production project must obtain a work permit.

sources.title: Bermuda Arts Council (Department of Culture, culture.bm; artscouncil.bm redirects here)
sources.said: BAC Project Grant $5,000 Ages: 18+ The Bermuda Arts Council Project Grant awards BMD $5,000 for the creation of a specific art project. The Project Grant is open to Bermudian Artists who are 18 years or older. … Grants cannot be used to support, or market completed works. All mediums are welcome. … BAC Stewardship & Production Grant $3,000 … awards BMD $3,000 for the presentation, performance, preservation, and/ or representation of Bermudian Art. … Organisation Grant $5,000 Ages: 21+ Supporting Bermuda-based arts organisations … The selected organisation will receive BMD $5,000 to fund arts-related events, shows, or initiatives … public art events, performances, exhibitions, or shows … Onion Bulb Grant $1,000 … open to Bermudian Artists of all ages. … Quarterly Grants Applications open: January 1, 2026 | Applications due: March 1, 2026 Applications open: April 1, 2026 | Applications due: June 1, 2026 Applications open: July 1, 2026 | Applications due: September 6, 2026 Applications open: October 1, 2026 | Applications due: December 6, 2026
